message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and at first, I was a bit frazzled. But then I remembered my stash of flashlights and power banks! I grabbed a couple of lanterns and set them up around the living room, creating a cozy glow. We made some hot cocoa and played board games by flashlight, turning the unexpected outage into a little adventure. It was such a nice reminder that sometimes, a little downtime can lead to the best memories. What’s your favorite way to make the best of a power outage?
